hypothesis: PHASE-3 Track A1 (sensor-penalty rebalance, accuracy end): run 612's post-mortem says tl=3 slack went to energy because the hardcoded sensor_rew=-0.25 dominated once missing-state churn was gone. This run weakens the penalty to -0.10 via the NEW --sensor-rew flag (implemented this phase in examples/finetune_deterministic.py: plumbed finetune() -> RealIoBTLearner -> RealIoBTEnv, both construction sites; reward-only, so the run-611 tl=3 base restores unchanged; smoke-tested as throwaway run 997, which reproduced run 612's 91.30%@1.49 baseline exactly). Otherwise identical to run 612: or_max + calibrators, soft-scale 0.8, soft-threshold 0.2, cam-smooth-bins 2, time-limit 3, 200 iters, --gps-eval, session 20250812_165739. Projection: sensors/step trades back up toward 3-4 and accuracy lands 96-98% (oracle bound 98.46%). OPERATIONAL: first launch (2026-09-01 00:25) was SIGTERM'd ~6s after Ray init by an external task kill (NOT an OOM — sar shows 34% mem used/17.7GB available at the time, no kernel/systemd-oomd/earlyoom log entries, and OOM kills use SIGKILL not SIGTERM; the run code is exonerated — the identical smoke config had just completed cleanly). findings: PARTIAL REBALANCE — the penalty is still doing most of the talking: best 94.85% at iter 65 (1.71 sensors/step), baseline 91.30% (1.49). Accuracy recovered +0.65pp over run 612 (94.20%) and now sits only 0.15pp under run 610 (95.00%) at ONE THIRD of 610's energy (1.71 vs 4.94 sensors/step) — a new strict improvement on the energy/accuracy frontier (dominates 612: +0.65pp for +0.19 sensors). BUT the 96-98% projection was not reached: halving the penalty (-0.25 -> -0.10) only nudged activation 1.49 -> 1.71 sensors, nowhere near the projected 3-4, so PPO's optimum is still deep in the frugal basin — accuracy pressure at this coverage saturates once the few high-value nodes are covered, and each extra sensor still costs more reward than the marginal soft-detection it buys. Implication for A2 (run 614, sensor_rew=-0.05): expect another modest activation rise, not a jump; if 614 also under-activates, the lever to force activation up is NOT the linear penalty but the coverage/lock side (cam-smooth 4 per experiments/diag_phase3_precheck.txt) or max_sensors 8 stacked on the best penalty. Same peak-then-decay shape as every run (best iter 65 of 200).
